items.evidence: leverage play <runs>/medium-engine-1 --ticks 1 --settings ./s0 printed {"tick":1,"screen":"title","menu_index":0,"language":"en","volume":5,"texts":["Hold the gate","Start","Settings","Quit"],"score":0,"wave":1,"gate_health":5,"guard_y":6,"walkers":[],"bolts":[]}; all brief keys present, tick = N.
Same run with --frame t0.png --size 800x480 wrote a PNG; file header says 800 x 480 RGBA; opened it and saw the title screen.
Title texts [Hold the gate, Start, Settings, Quit]; inputs 1:down,2:enter -> screen settings; 1:enter -> screen play, wave 1, score 0, gate_health 5.
Settings, 8 x right from 5 -> volume 10 (not past, no wrap); next run 14 x left from 10 -> 0; right,right,left from 5 -> 6.

down to Language, right -> language es, settings texts all Spanish (Ajustes, Volumen: 5, Idioma: Espanol, Atras; title words too); later runs: title [Defiende la puerta, Empezar, Ajustes, Salir], play [Puntos: 0, Oleada 1 de 5, Puerta: 0..5], pause [En pausa, Continuar, Titulo], won/lost [Has ganado/Has perdido, Puntos: N, Enter: titulo]. No English left (Enter is the key name).
Run with --settings ./s1 set volume 10; next run with ./s1 started at 10. Run with ./s3 set es; next run with ./s3 started es (volume 5). --settings ./fresh started en, volume 5.
Hold up 30 ticks: guard_y 6 -> 9.0 (6 units/s); hold down 30 ticks: 6 -> 3.0; hold up 200 ticks -> 12; hold down 300 ticks -> 0 (stops at edges).
Holding shoot from tick 2: bolts appear at ticks 3, 27, 51, 75 (24 ticks apart, never more); x grows 0.2333/tick (14 u/s); first bolt at x 19.97 on tick 79, gone on tick 80.
Seed 1 idle: walkers spawn at x=20 on ticks 1, 91, 181, 271, 361 (every 90), lanes 4,10,6,2,6; 5 walkers in wave 1 (none more at tick 500); x falls 4.2 in 168 ticks (1.5 u/s).

Guard at y=4 shooting: walker (y=4) health 2 -> 1 and the bolt vanished between ticks 81-103; second bolt destroyed it by tick 112, score 0 -> 10. Bolts at y=6 flew past a y=4 walker with its health staying 2.

Seed 1 idle: gate 5 -> 4 at tick ~815 as the first walker reached x 0 and was removed; at tick 1165 screen lost, gate 0, texts [..., You lost, Score: 0, Enter: title]; frame shows the lost panel with score.
Traced a winning run (seed 1) with --follow: wave 1 field empty at tick 580, wave 2 and 'Wave 2 of 5' at tick 760 (180 ticks = 3 s); 7 walkers spawned in wave 2 (5/7/9/11/13 across waves).

Recorded my own bot's inputs, then replayed them as a plain --inputs headless run (seed 1, 5377 ticks): screen won, score 450, gate 5, texts [..., You won, Score: 450, Enter: title]; adding 5378:enter -> screen title. Same in Spanish settings.

Escape at tick 60: state at tick 200 identical to tick 60 (walker x 18.525, bolts same), screen paused. Enter (Resume) at 200: tick 210 walkers/bolts equal an unpaused run at tick 70 (only guard_y differs, because escape releases held up as the brief's input rule says). Escape, down, enter -> title.
Two runs seed 1, 400 ticks, same script: md5 identical (8c302e65...). Seed 2 lanes [10,10,6,10,8], seed 7 [6,10,6,10,8] vs seed 1 [4,10,6,2,6].

play.png at tick 300: guard at (2,4) -> px (80,320); walkers (14.78,10),(17.03,6 orange, health 1),(19.28,2) and three bolts at y=4 drawn where the state says (40 px/unit, y up); green gate bar at x=0; HUD 'Score: 10  Wave 1 of 5  Gate: 5'.
Frames: title (Start marked by ring), Spanish title with menu_index 1 (Ajustes ringed), settings English (Volume ringed) and Spanish (Idioma: Espanol ringed), all in the chosen language.
assets/strings/en.json and es.json hold every word; ui/*.json use @keys; lib.rs has no shown words. README 'Adding a language' says to copy en.json to <code>.json, set locale/name, translate.
README has How to play, the exact headless-run and frame commands (with leverage play <runs>/medium-engine-1); I ran them as written from a fresh folder with no engine started and they worked.

defects: While Settings is open, texts also lists the title screen's words (Hold the gate, Start, Settings, Quit) under it; the frame shows only a faint title behind the panel (README admits it).
On the title, Start keeps its bright blue 'primary' fill when the focus moves to another entry, so two entries look highlighted; only the thin ring marks the chosen one.
Enter on Quit in a headless run leaves the screen as title with nothing reported, so Quit could not be seen to do anything headless.
Pause has no Settings entry (the brief only asks for Resume, Title; this is noted, not a fault).
Starting a second run from the title in the same session does not reseed: its walker lanes differ from the seed's first run (still deterministic for the same inputs).

trace.how: context, new, read_again and how far the context grew are the run's own records. written_out a request is its growth less its answers (characters / 4), scaled to the run's exact total; of_which_unseen is that less the visible text (thinking). cost is what the request read and wrote, weighted; carried is what reading again what it added cost at every later request (start.carried: the same for what every request starts from). reading + writing is in_the_ledger
